title: Canceled member sees no resubscribe or 'ends on' path; account says 'Canceled' with no date and a free-trial CTA is shown to ex-members on landing
persona: Member whose membership is canceled (period end in future / past)
steps: Create qa_can_21 (canceled, period end +5d) and qa_can_41 (canceled, period end -2d) via webhook.
Open /account as qa_can_21: shows 'Canceled · access until Nov 26, 2026' and only 'Manage billing on Whop'; no way back/resubscribe nudge.

Open /slate as qa_can_41: redirected to /?membership=expired, banner 'Your membership has ended. See your account or subscribe again.' (no end date). Landing hero below still says 'START 7-DAY FREE TRIAL / 7 days free' to someone who is a returning member; /account for qa_can_41 shows status just 'Canceled' and 'Renews / ends' = the past date.
The in-banner links 'See your account' and 'subscribe again' are 17px tall.
expected: Banner/account say what happened (canceled on X, access ended on Y) and give a clear one-tap way back; tap targets >= 44px; ex-members not pitched a free trial they cannot get.
actual: Messages are correct about the state but thin, the 'Canceled' state has no date once ended, and inline links are 17px high.
